root_cause: The Instagram growth calendar was created before Mira Reel-only v3 and still contained legacy carousel/Placid recommendations. The daily-winner selector correctly rejected those rows, producing NO_ELIGIBLE_MIRA_DAILY_WINNER even though a Mira daily-life seed existed.
prevention_rule: Normalize every Mira daily-life Instagram recommendation at the database boundary to format=reel, production_route=openart_video and reel_generator=OpenArt before winner selection; remove legacy visual_generator routing and clean already-planned stale seeds. Preserve the same immutable winner/job through provider recovery.
evidence: The 2026-09-22 Mira calendar seed was suggested but had format=carousel and production_route=placid_visual while 2026-09-21 and 2026-09-23 were already Reel/OpenArt.
The canonical materializer returned NO_ELIGIBLE_MIRA_DAILY_WINNER before normalization.
After normalization, the same recommendation became the immutable Reel winner and one OpenArt media job was materialized.
Twenty-eight future Mira daily-life recommendations through December still used carousel/Placid before the migration.
Production migration readback returned stale_count=0 after cleanup.
terminal_rule: Complete only after protected merge, exact main readback, and production readback proving zero stale Mira Reel-policy recommendations.
